_comment: Intentional changes to how a release reports data written by the previous release. Each entry silences the upgrade migration check for one path (a settings endpoint key such as '/api/preferences.language', an event key such as '/api/events.details.from', or a history field such as '/api/heatpump/temperature-history.samples.mode'). Every entry needs a reason. Remove entries once the release they describe has shipped.

ignore.reason: Canada's permanent zones now use their official abbreviations, so the bench's America/Vancouver zone derives <PCT>7 instead of 3.5.2's MST7 (same UTC-7 offset).
